title: The Quantum Zeno Effect
description: Measure a system often enough and it never gets the chance to change: each measurement starts it over. Unlocks the Zeno Anchor, which keeps chunks loaded.

puzzle.goal: A system that would leave its state on a timescale T is measured N times, evenly, over a time t. Write the chance P that it is still found where it started.
puzzle.name: Zeno survival
puzzle.ask: Find P for t = @{t} s, T = @{T} s and N = @{N} measurements.
puzzle.method: Between looks it leaks out only quadratically, (Δt/T)², with Δt = t/N; N such steps give e^(−t²/(NT²)).
